limitations: The impact is potential; the plan encodes the report-supported conditional scenario rather than an inevitable effect.

Caller authorization for addRewards is not stated and is not encoded.

The reentrancy window is represented by grounded Boolean observables because the report gives no numeric accounting values.
Other entrypoints besides claimRewards are not individually enumerated in the report.
Griefing is represented as a qualitative Boolean outcome because the report provides no numeric magnitude or specific harmed quantity.
The plan formalizes only the selected impact 'griefing' for the single intent 'intent_no_reentry_window'; other impacts and intents are handled separately.
The selected impact is potential and conditional; the plan does not assert that token theft is inevitable.
The reentrancy window and accounting-increase ordering are represented as grounded Boolean observables rather than numeric amounts.
Other selected intents for this impact, if any, are formalized in separate independent claims and are not combined here.
Runtime binding of the malicious token behavior and entrypoint re-entry is deferred to later stages.
